data.offering_description: Owns and leases fiber and copper communications networks to telecom carriers, and sells broadband internet service to residential and business customers in rural US markets. Network capacity is leased under long-term contracts and retail service is sold on monthly subscriptions.

data.primary_products: fiber network capacity; dark fiber; copper network access; broadband internet

data.primary_services: network leasing; fiber construction and maintenance; managed network connectivity

data.customer_segment: B2B: wireless carriers, telecom operators, enterprises, data centers; B2C: residential broadband subscribers in rural areas

data.end_markets: telecommunications; wireless; enterprise connectivity; residential broadband

data.revenue_model: rental or leasing: long-term leases of fiber and copper network assets to carriers; subscription: monthly broadband internet subscriptions; service fees: network construction, maintenance and connectivity services

data.value_chain_position: asset operator: owns and runs fiber and copper networks, sold as leased capacity to carriers; service provider: sells broadband internet service to households and businesses

data.geography_served: US national: fiber and copper network assets across many US states, with retail broadband concentrated in rural southern and central states

data.specialization: related lines: network infrastructure leasing and retail broadband service sharing the same fiber and copper network

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: contracts with carriers and enterprise customers; online: online sign-up and account management for broadband subscribers

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: telecom carrier rules from the FCC and state utility commissions, plus REIT tax rules for the real estate structure

P1.2.text: Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. We build, operate, and deliver fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy.

P1.3.text: Kinetic serves homes and businesses with ultra-fast, reliable internet solutions designed for today’s digital world. Visit kinetic to learn more.

P1.5.text: Welcome to the new Uniti — your premier fiber infrastructure provider.

P1.6.text: With the integration of Windstream, Uniti has emerged as a more powerful and agile company. With our national network, expanded services, and unwavering commitment to customers, we deliver world-class connectivity solutions. From custom enterprise networks spanning multiple locations to wholesale infrastructure that scales with your requirements, Uniti provides high-performance connectivity built for the future.

P1.8.text: With an industry-leading fiber backbone, Uniti Wholesale delivers greater reach, capacity, and redundancy.

P1.10.text: Uniti offers a robust suite of managed solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of modern businesses.

P1.12.text: Uniti delivers high-performance connectivity to businesses and government organizations nationwide.

P1.14.text: Kinetic serves homes and businesses with ultra-fast, reliable Internet solutions designed for today's digital world.

P1.15.text: Unmatched Network. Unrivaled Service. Future-Ready Connectivity.

P1.16.text: At Uniti, we are redefining what it means to be a fiber infrastructure provider. With a nationwide fiber footprint, cutting-edge technology, and a customer-first mindset, we are empowering businesses, communities, and individuals with seamless, secure, and scalable connectivity solutions.

P1.17.text: Our expanded network gives you access to one of America’s most extensive fiber footprints, connecting your business wherever you operate.

P1.18.text: We prioritize your business needs with expanded fiber access, industry-leading reliability, and a seamless customer experience.

P1.19.text: From connecting remote offices to delivering enterprise-grade managed solutions, we support your business goals of today and tomorrow.

P2.2.text: Shaping a future for every customer we serve.

P2.3.text: Our fiber connectivity solutions drive a new digital economy and enable success for all of our customers.

P2.4.text: Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States.

P2.5.text: With a steadfast commitment to customer service, operational excellence, and superior network capabilities, Uniti builds, operates and delivers critical fiber-based communications services to connect and empower people and businesses.

P2.6.text: Our brands offer a full suite of advanced infrastructure solutions:​

P2.7.text: We build customer-driven dark fiber infrastructure and provide tailored high-capacity wavelengths, ethernet and cell site backhaul leveraging our optical transport network for carriers, hyperscalers, government, and Fortune multiple customers across the U.S. and Canada.

P2.8.text: We build and operate fiber networks and provide transformative multi-Gigabit internet access to homes and businesses in small and medium-sized communities across the Southeast, Southwest, Northeast and Midwest U.S.

P2.9.text: We build and operate fiber networks and provide next-generation solutions to businesses including banks, hospitals, schools and governments in communities across the Southeast.

P2.10.text: We deliver a full suite of industry-leading and scalable managed cloud solutions and security services with end-to-end technical support tailored for mid-to-large enterprises across the U.S.

P2.11.text: We harness the collective expertise of our team to shape a future where fiber connectivity solutions drive a new digital economy and enable success for every customer we serve.

P2.12.text: Join us in advancing a connected future. Discover how Uniti’s premier fiber solutions can elevate your home, business and community.

P2.13.text: Kenny Gunderman President & Chief Executive Officer

P2.15.text: Daniel Heard Sr. EVP & General Counsel

P1.1.text: Investing in Communications Infrastructure and Services | ATN

P1.2.text: ATN operates in historically underbuilt and underserved markets and provides a diverse portfolio of communications services companies with strong competitive position.

P1.3.text: We digitally empower people and communities to connect with the world and prosper.

P1.4.text: The need for fast and reliable connectivity is driving critical communications infrastructure and services growth across the globe, and we have a proven playbook to successfully address that unmet need.

P1.5.text: Strong Competitive Positions in Remote and Historically Underserved Markets

P1.6.text: Our focus is operating communications infrastructure and services in underbuilt and underserved markets where there is demand and need for fast and reliable communications infrastructures.

P1.7.text: We harness decades of local service operations management and expertise to create a customer-centric experience to strengthen our competitive position in the markets we serve.

P1.8.text: To bring social and economic prosperity by providing and inspiring underserved people and communities with the best digital connectivity the world has to offer.

P1.9.text: We have vast experience bringing connectivity to historically underbuilt and underserved rural and remote areas of the world where it is challenging to do so, such as the Caribbean, western U.S., the Navajo Nation and Alaska.

P1.10.text: In these rural and remote markets, demand for reliable high-speed communications is strong making it a perfect opportunity for technology-driven social and economic change. Our investment in infrastructure and operations excellence allows us to deliver best-in-class solutions and provide access to opportunity and the global marketplace: a marketplace for both ideas and commerce. And where we can go includes greater reach, growth and a positive impact for the people and communities we serve.

P1.12.text: The value we provide is demonstrated in the diversified markets we serve and the infrastructure and local brands that maintain strong competitive positions in attractive, historically underbuilt and underserved markets.

P1.13.text: Join to Help Make a Global Impact

P1.14.text: Be part of a driven, dedicated team focused on elevating the health and wellbeing of historically overlooked and underserved rural and remote communities through the delivery of the communications services everyone needs and deserves.

P2.2.text: ATN International: A Leading Provider of Communication Infrastructure and Services

P2.3.text: ATN has been investing in communications infrastructure for more than 30 years across the globe through local brands. We have a proven operational strategy that has enabled us to expand our position in historically underserved rural and remote markets.

P2.4.text: We believe communications services should be easy, equitable, and ubiquitous. Our mission is to digitally empower people and communities so that they can connect with the world and prosper.

P2.5.text: Proving Essential Services with Excellence in Customer Delight

P2.6.text: We prioritize customer satisfaction from the ground up to better serve our communities.

P2.7.text: We build network infrastructure to facilitate digital connectivity, provide access to life-changing services, and enable true socioeconomic advancement.

P2.8.text: We are deeply committed to forging lasting local partnerships and helping the communities we enter succeed over the long term.

P2.9.text: We hire local management teams and create local jobs. There are often many skilled people in underserved markets with few job opportunities.

P2.11.text: and possess 35+ years of global communications investment experience

P2.12.text: Operations in Bermuda, Cayman, Guyana, US Virgin Islands and rural western US and Alaska
